name: consultants-pack
description: Claude for Consultants · Team in Claude: 39 Claude skills for winning and shaping client work when the client has AI too, from their brief to the signed scope, as eight desks in order: Intake reads the client's brief, qualifies the opportunity and records the bid or no-bid decision; Discovery prepares the call, keeps the notes and sends the recap email; Problem writes the problem statement, the issue tree and the hypothesis test plan; Strategy builds options and the recommendation memo; Pricing shapes good-better-best options, fees and a MoSCoW scope; Proposal writes the consulting proposal, the AI use statement and the statement of work; the Client room prepares the walk-through deck, the AI objection answer and the negotiation plan; Follow-through covers follow-up emails, the mutual action plan and the win/loss review. For independent consultants and partners in advisory practices. Claude structures, drafts and checks; it never invents a reference, a result, a number or a client quote, and you run the conversation, make the recommendation and send everything yourself.
